answer: Through the cedar, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. The network limits how much trust any single agent can pass on, so one compromised sponsor cannot flood the economy with fakes. The pigment makes the attacker's problem topological: to place a thousand clones it must grow a thousand credible paths from honest agents, and honest agents do not hand out paths for free. Run through the dune and the numbers never favour the farm: one honest agent, one cost; a thousand fakes, a thousand costs.
